name: Olivia Neal
life: “I still remember turning back from a lesson I had already told my friends about.” People around the corner by Juniper Tailor know Olivia by a small Friday habit. Olivia looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I am learning to swim and wanted a heroic last lesson. The guard taught me to read the signs and choose tomorrow instead.
appearance: Olivia is easy to recognize by short black hair swept back and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair, Olivia listens with the head tilted a little to the left when listening.
personality: Olivia thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Olivia sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To learn when to choose a different swimming day.
family: Julian Kapoor is Olivia’s older cousin. Olivia gets to change the plan. Julian offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *A clean coat for court*, Julian says, “I insured his old business and denied the first claim.”
connections: Olive Baines. A widowed regular shows a learner what an evening at the sea can be without entering it.

reactions.situation: A passerby assumes the beach is still staffed
reactions.response: Olivia points out the published end of cover and gets the passerby an accurate answer about tomorrow.
